Global context does not become foreign actionable ticker scope

acceptance: Calendar defaults to US

Foreign Global Context does not automatically activate full U.S. market-critical Event Mode
Routine low-utility foreign calendar fetches are removed/deprioritized

GLD/SLV/USO retain explicit tradable priority

scope_lock.name: Data Utility & Evidence Value

No orphan data is accepted by release gate
Global/macro data states its U.S.-market decision-context consumer

scope_lock.name: Adaptive Data Health / Freshness / Cache
acceptance: Session-aware freshness remains intact
Provider/cache/check/data timestamps remain observable
Fallback/stale reason/recovery remain visible
Adaptive policy changes remain Shadow/validation governed

acceptance: Canonical release identity prevents metadata drift
